_readme: Small config the agent reads/writes each run. artifactUrl is filled in after the first successful publish and must be reused (not regenerated) on every subsequent run so updates land on the same page instead of creating a new one each day.
pagesPublishScope: every run — uses GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN if set (scheduled cloud runs), else the local gh CLI
lastRunStatus: Weekly research run. Under-covered-role target: Network Engineering (3 tagged opportunities entering this run, tied with Help Desk/IT Support, QA/Test Engineering, Security/InfoSec, Data Engineering; Product Management lowest at 2 but already had two dedicated runs without closing the gap, so rotated per the 2026-11-16 run's recommendation). Dedicated searches across McKinsey/Gartner/Forrester/IDC/Deloitte/BLS found only narrative commentary (McKinsey's 2026 tech trends outlook on softening network-build-out hiring and AIOps displacing manual network ops) with no disclosed sample or network-specific quantified metric -- nothing cleared the admission bar, so Network Engineering stays at 3 by design. Census BTOS (mandatory every run) was searched; the three working papers it surfaced (CES-WP-26-25, CES-WP-26-61, CES-WP-26-27) are all already cited in the catalog under different framing -- no new admission (consecutiveEmptyRuns 3->4). One substantive update: a direct Stanford Digital Economy Lab search surfaced an August 2026 revision of the already-cited 'Canaries in the Coal Mine' study (entry-level-hiring-contraction-mixed-evidence) widening the AI-exposed early-career employment gap from 13% to 19% on an expanded dataset -- updated the existing evidence row in place (re-verification, not a new institution), evidenceScore unchanged at 4. Data-quality fix: `stale` is a static field that doesn't recompute itself against today's date, so a full audit found six opportunities incorrectly marked stale:false (ai-adoption-access-gap-income-education, flatter-orgs-wider-spans-of-control, ai-infrastructure-network-skills-gap, ceo-mandate-ai-operational-capability-overhaul, enterprise-architect-role-redefined-around-agentic-ai, data-foundation-investment-differentiates-ai-success) -- corrected to stale:true. Red-teamed all thirteen evidenceScore>=4 opportunities (lastRedTeamedDate 2026-11-23); no new reliability>=3 contradicting evidence found beyond what's already recorded. No new opportunities founded; no opportunity archived (none aged out of the 12-month window). IDC crossed further past the possibly-dead threshold (consecutiveEmptyRuns 6->7); Forrester approaching it (now 5). See data/findings_log/2026-11-23.md for full detail.
pagesTokenPermissions: fine-grained PAT, repository access limited to sdm1130/ai-it-research-tracker, Contents: Read and write (Metadata: Read-only is added automatically). Nothing else required: main has no branch protection or rulesets, and Pages is build_type=legacy on main:/ so it rebuilds on push.

pagesPublishExitCodes.3: no credentials — skip and report mirror stale
pagesPublishExitCodes.1: real failure e.g. expired token — report loudly
